# The refusal gate's table (TestNoRefusalButInputsAndLimits): every error the
# inference packages make, by file and literal (Go-quoted; %v stands for each
# part of a sum that is not a literal), and what it is:
#
#   input    the caller's request or the file's contents fail a check
#   limit    a device, driver or OS states a bound
#   fault    an outside call failed and reports it
#   bug      the engine's own contract broken; reaching it is a defect
#   context  names where; the cause is the error or reason it carries
#   skip     an arm not taken, the same answer through another
#   refusal  a feature the engine does not do: the work list, each with why
#
# class<TAB>file<TAB>literal[<TAB>why], one line each, by file.
limit	backend/backend.go	"%s does not report a subgroup-width guarantee, so %d lanes cannot be assumed"	a device that promises no subgroup width: its own statement, and the kernel asked has a scalar twin
bug	backend/backend.go	"backend: %s: %s declares a %dx%dx%d workgroup and was launched %d wide"
bug	backend/backend.go	"backend: copy of %d bytes from offset %d of a %d-byte buffer"
bug	backend/backend.go	"backend: copy of %d bytes from offset %d to %d of one buffer overlaps itself"
bug	backend/backend.go	"backend: copy of %d bytes from offset %d to %d: negative"
bug	backend/backend.go	"backend: copy of %d bytes from offset %d to %d: not whole 4-byte words"
